scope: DXF MTEXT group-73 output and LibreCAD R2018 column-extents test compatibility

references.name: Autodesk MTEXT group codes
references.relevance: Group 73 defines 1 for at least and 2 for exact.

references.name: ezdxf MTEXT internals
references.relevance: R2018 column data resides in an embedded object and carries total extents.

line_spacing.before: Standalone MTEXT and embedded MTEXT wrote group 73 directly from the public unsigned style, including invalid values 0 and 7.
line_spacing.after: Both DXF writers emit 2 only for source 2 and otherwise emit default 1; the caller model is not mutated. This deliberately normalizes out-of-domain styles on output.
line_spacing.scope_limit: DXF output only; DWG serialization and the reader remain unchanged.

source_column_witness.provenance_limit: Repository provides the sample; the original CAD authoring application is not independently verified here.

consumer_patch.reason: Change a stale test that expected the embedded R2018 column extents to be discarded to check the observed retained values.

validation.generated: 40 standalone outputs: AC1018/AC1021/AC1027/AC1032, ASCII/Binary, styles 0/1/2/7/65535. Ten embedded AC1032 ASCII/Binary outputs use the same styles. Fresh libdxfrw readback checks style and unchanged caller models.
validation.independent_peer: ezdxf 1.4.5 parsed all 40 generated standalone outputs and saw the expected group-73 style.
validation.librecad: Disposable upstream-linked fast target, with previously documented test API patch and the column test correction, passed [mtext]~[dwg]: 4 cases / 215 assertions; [dxf_codec] passed 21 cases / 487 assertions.
validation.known_existing_failure: The upstream libdxfrw mtext-column-object-scope selector still fails ten fresh embedded orientation assertions and logs six BAD_CODE_PARSED reads. Recompiling the HEAD version of src/libdxfrw.cpp into an otherwise identical test binary reproduces exactly the same ten failures and six read errors; root cause remains to be investigated.

limits: The local LibreCAD test patch is not merged upstream.
No LibreCAD_3 or native FreeCAD qualification follows from these controls.
